_readme: Power-ups offered after qualifying encounters. The game always shows 5: four are exactly what they say, and one has had a random catch from catches.json secretly attached to it. Because the catch is attached at selection time rather than baked in, the same power-up can be clean one run and cursed the next - players cannot memorise which card is the trap. 'target': party = everyone, one = a chosen/random crew member, run = global run modifier.

powerups.name: Quiet Shoes
powerups.description: +2 Stealth for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: Traded for four desserts and a favour.

powerups.name: Protein Stash
powerups.description: +2 Strength for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: Chalky, expired, and extremely effective.

powerups.name: Stolen Schematics
powerups.description: +2 Intelligence for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: Nine pages. Two of them are the same page.

powerups.name: A Word From A Lawyer
powerups.description: +2 Charisma for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: Nobody has paid him. Nobody intends to.

powerups.name: Somebody's Lucky Foot
powerups.description: +2 Luck for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: It was not lucky for its original owner.

powerups.name: Actual Running Shoes
powerups.description: +2 Speed for the whole crew.
powerups.flavor: One size. Everybody insists it is their size.

powerups.name: Medical Kit
powerups.description: Heal the whole crew for 5, and +1 max health each.
powerups.flavor: Mostly bandages. One mystery ampoule.

powerups.name: The Guard Schedule
powerups.description: -15 Heat now, and Heat decays by 2 every room.
powerups.flavor: Laminated. Somebody laminated it.

powerups.name: A Roll Of Cash
powerups.description: +80 money immediately.
powerups.flavor: Rolled tightly. Suspiciously tightly.

powerups.name: A Mysterious Key
powerups.description: +15% on all technical and planning checks.
powerups.flavor: It opens something. Everybody assumes it is a door.

powerups.name: Steel Nerves
powerups.description: Critical failures are 15% less likely.
powerups.flavor: Achieved through breathing exercises and denial.

powerups.name: Beginner's Luck
powerups.description: Critical successes are 12% more likely.
powerups.flavor: Nobody here is a beginner. It works anyway.

powerups.name: Smuggled Tools
powerups.description: +15% on all physical checks.
powerups.flavor: Came in inside a cake. A structurally ambitious cake.

powerups.name: Silver Tongue
powerups.description: +15% on all social checks.
powerups.flavor: Purely a state of mind. Alarmingly effective.

powerups.name: The Ghost Route
powerups.description: +18% on all stealth checks and -10 Heat.
powerups.flavor: Four men have used it. Three of them successfully.

powerups.name: Second Wind
powerups.description: Revive anyone unconscious and heal the crew for 4.
powerups.flavor: Largely adrenaline and refusal.

powerups.name: Thick Skin
powerups.description: Take 1 less damage from everything.
powerups.flavor: Earned, unfortunately.

powerups.name: An Insider Contact
powerups.description: +25 money every room, and -8 Heat now.
powerups.flavor: Works here. Hates it here. Very helpful.

powerups.name: Cool Head
powerups.description: All Heat you generate is reduced by 30%.
powerups.flavor: The crew has collectively decided to be calm.

powerups.name: A Written Plan B
powerups.description: +20% on every check during the final escape.
powerups.flavor: Two pages, in pencil, mostly legible.

powerups.name: One Do-Over
powerups.description: The first failed check of each room is re-rolled once.
powerups.flavor: Nobody is sure how this is possible. It is.

powerups.name: A Spare Uniform
powerups.description: -20 Heat immediately.
powerups.flavor: It says HALLIWELL. Nobody has raised it.

powerups.name: Bigger Lungs
powerups.description: +3 max health for everyone, and heal 3.
powerups.flavor: Result of a sustained campaign against the stairs.

powerups.name: Tunnel Rat
powerups.description: +25% on anything underground.
powerups.flavor: A skill and, regrettably, an identity.

powerups.name: Gift Of The Gab
powerups.description: +3 Charisma and +1 Luck to one crew member.
powerups.flavor: Bestowed by the crew, in a vote, reluctantly.

powerups.name: A Length Of Iron Bar
powerups.description: +3 Strength and +1 Speed to one crew member.
powerups.flavor: Was previously part of something load-bearing.

powerups.name: Somebody's Reading Glasses
powerups.description: +3 Intelligence and +1 Charisma to one crew member.
powerups.flavor: Wrong prescription. Right confidence.

powerups.name: A Black Market Tab
powerups.description: +50 money, and successful checks pay out 12 more.
powerups.flavor: Credit, in here, is an act of extraordinary trust.
